Wolfe Research Raises PT on Micron Technology (MU) Stock

Micron Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ:MU) is one of the Best Bargain Stocks to Buy in June. On June 11, Wolfe Research lifted its price objective on the company’s stock to $1,250 from $550 and maintained an “Outperform” rating.
